source_of_truth: Read by hand across two files: DELETE /api/account calls ensureLoggedIn(request), and gate.ts shows ensureLoggedIn reads the session cookie and throws 401 for anonymous callers. So authorization IS enforced; the route is correctly guarded. Whether the handler is safe cannot be decided from route.ts alone — the auditor only sees the handler body, where the helper name (ensureLoggedIn) is outside its auth-name vocabulary. A correct auditor that followed the import would not flag this; the single-file heuristic has insufficient context to judge it.

forbidden.why_not_a_defect: the handler delegates the session check to ensureLoggedIn(), which reads the session cookie and throws 401; authorization is enforced, the auditor just cannot see it from the handler body.
